info.title: Positioning Interface API
info.description: Backend API contract for station and train presence positioning data. Consumed by the control room dashboard and the steward Android app. A single Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream pushes the Dashboard to every client.

get.description: Returns how much time must remain before an area becomes overdue for the area to be considered at-risk. Clients use this to show warning states before an area turns overdue.

post.description: Sets how much time must remain before an area becomes overdue for the area to be considered at-risk. Returns the updated configuration.

200.description: Threshold updated. Returns the new at-risk threshold configuration.

400.description: Invalid threshold value, e.g. a non-positive number of minutes

get.description: Server-Sent Events stream (text/event-stream). Every message is an SSE event named `dashboard` whose `data` is a JSON-encoded Dashboard. Every event contains every station and train, changed or not, so clients replace their whole state on each event. An event is sent each time the server recomputes coverage: when a positioning or patrol session event arrives, and periodically, even when nothing changed. The stream stays open until the client disconnects.

200.description: Open SSE stream. Each event's data is a Dashboard.

500.description: Internal server error before the stream was opened

total_time_secs.description: Total elapsed time, in seconds, since the train started being tracked.

manned_time_secs.description: Total time, in seconds, the train has been manned by a steward.

current_steward_ids.description: UUIDs of the stewards currently manning the train; empty if unmanned.

line.description: The metro lines the train serves (e.g. ["M1", "M2"]).

area_id.description: Identifier of the patrol area, unique within its station.

line.description: The metro lines the area serves.

area_type.description: Kind of area. Decides how long a visit must last to count as a patrol.

covered_now.description: True while a steward is patrolling the area right now.

overdue_at.description: The moment the area becomes overdue (or became overdue). Clients count down to it themselves between events. Null when covered_now is true, or when the area has never been patrolled and so has no deadline. UTC in ISO 8601 with offset.

station_id.description: Stable identifier of the station, from the station dataset.

areas.description: Patrol areas belonging to this station.

time.description: When the server sent this event. UTC in ISO 8601 with offset.

at_risk_threshold_minutes.description: Minutes before an area becomes overdue when it is considered at-risk. E.g. 15 means an area is at-risk when less than 15 minutes remain until overdue_at.

message.description: Human-readable error message intended for developers
